'''Dune worms''' were dangerous [[Worm/Legends|worms]] that inhabited the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], though they were rumored to also call the rocky [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] home. With skin the [[Color/Legends|color]] of sand, they had enormous [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and small beady [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and were attracted to movement. A young dune worm ten [[Foot/Legends|feet]] in length was considered small. The feeling of being caught in a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] was sometimes compared to the bite of a dune worm. A few weeks after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was confronted by a young dune worm while searching for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="The Hunt for Han Solo" />
